# tenure inquirer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureInquirer`](gmeow-tenureInquirer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureInquirer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent whose open question an inquiry-tenure records. Functional: one tenure, one inquirer; two agents holding the same question open are two tenures sharing one [`gmeow:tenureQuestion`](gmeow-tenureQuestion.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureInquirer`](gmeow-tenureInquirer.md) from [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) to the single agent whose holding-open of the question over time it records.

### Avoid when

- Avoid on a bare [`gmeow:asks`](gmeow-asks.md) statement (the agent there is the statement subject) and avoid more than one inquirer per tenure; it is functional — one tenure, one agent.

### How to use

- Point the tenure at exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), matching the subject of the [`gmeow:asks`](gmeow-asks.md) statement the tenure reifies; two agents asking the same question are two tenures sharing one [`gmeow:tenureQuestion`](gmeow-tenureQuestion.md).
